name: B2W Initiative
description: Marketing site for Bangladesh 2 World Initiative — study-abroad guidance, profile assessment, scholarships and visa support for Bangladeshi talent.
detail: Next.js 15 front end for B2WI: hero and impact stats, service grid (university research, SOP/LOR review, visa, accommodation, scholarships), testimonials, scholarship updates and insights. Built with React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind, Radix UI and next-themes dark mode. Live at b2wi.com.

stack.frontend: Next.js 15 · React 19 · TypeScript · Tailwind · Radix UI · next-themes
